title: zea mays subsp. aorista
intro: Zea mays subsp. aorista, commonly known as Aorita corn, is a subspecies of corn that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Aorita corn include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents in Aorita corn also exhibit anti-diabetic and anti-cancer properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
